hooks.command: f=$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path); case $f in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) mise x -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" -- bunx oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
[ "$(jq -r .stop_hook_active)" = true ] || mise x -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" -- bunx dandori --fix >&2 || exit 2
